docs:
Dialog from ARLing Motion (MIT).
React: import { Dialog } from "@/components/ui/motion-dialog".
The logic is in lib/arling-motion-dialog.js (typed by the .d.ts next to it) and works without React: createDialog on your own markup.
Styles were added to your global CSS under @layer components (Tailwind v4).
With Tailwind v3 or no Tailwind, add https://arling.sk/motion/components/dialog/dialog.css to your styles instead.
Live demo and docs: https://arling.sk/motion/#dialog
